The Puppet Master |birthdate = {{Birth date and age|1973|1|2|mf=yes}}https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Big_Brother_2_houseguests_(U.S.) |hometown = Miami, FL |occupation = Physician |ProfileInputAnyText = Yes |SocialMediaInputAnyText= Yes |Season2=7 (US) |Place2=4th |Votes2=1 |Alliances2=[[Chilltown]] |Loyalties2=[[Mike Malin]] |HOHs2=0 |Nominations2=2 (Week 3 & 9) |Veto Wins2=0 |Days2=65 |Currently=Jury Member |Currently2=Jury Member |Season=2 (US) |Place=1st |Votes=1 |Votestowin=6
(1 Nullified) |Alliances=[[Chilltown]] |Loyalties=[[Mike Malin]]
[[Shannon Dragoo]] |HOHs=0 |Nominations=4 (Weeks 3, 5, 8 & 10) |Veto Wins= |Days=82 |OtherPrizes= |Currently1=Winner |Vetos2 = 0|TwitterUserName = drwillkirby|InstagramUserName = drwillkirby1|FacebookUserName = drwillkirby}} '''Dr. William "Dr. Will" Kirby''' is the [[Winners (US)|winner]] of ''[[Big Brother 2 (US)]]''. He would later return in ''[[Big Brother 7 (US)]]''. On ''Big Brother 2 (US)'', Will was known for his [[Chilltown|friendship]] with fellow housemate [[Mike Malin|Mike "Boogie" Malin]] and his [[Showmance|showmance]] with [[Shannon Dragoo]]. Even though he drew the ire of many of his fellow houseguests and was nominated four times through the season, Will was able to stay in the game with the help of his charismatic personality, clever social maneuvers, and over the top strategies, making the target on his back so big that he was able to hide in plain sight. While he failed to win the final Head of Household, he was taken to the final 2 by [[Nicole Nilson Schaffrich]]. At the end of the jury questionnaire, Will rubbed many of the [[Jury|jurors]] the wrong way with his final jury speech. Despite this, most of the jury respected Will's game, and he won the $500,000 grand prize by a 5-2 [[Jury|jury]] vote over Nicole. On ''Big Brother 7 (US)'', Will entered the house with a huge target on his back due to being the only winner in the game. However, with the help of fellow ''Big Brother 2'' housemate and "Chilltown" member Mike "Boogie", Will was able to manipulate other houseguests (most notably his new showmance parter [[Janelle Pierzina]]) and managed to get rid of big names like [[Howie Gordon]], [[James Rhine]], and [[Danielle Reyes]] just to name a few. Will's ultimate demise was during the final 4 when [[Erika Landin]] and Janelle caught onto Chilltown's schemes. Since Mike "Boogie" was the HOH of that week and could not be evicted, Janelle, the Power of Veto holder of that week, casted the sole vote to evict Will from the house, making him the 6th member of the jury. At the finale, Will voted for his ally Mike "Boogie" to win the game.

Yankee Swap.lead:
{{Recurring Competition | description= A competition where houseguests can either swap or keep prizes, punishments, and the veto or HOH. | seasonsappeared=[[Big Brother 8 (US)]] - [[Big Brother 27 (US)]]
[[Big Brother Canada 2]]
[[Celebrity Big Brother Quebec 2]] - present | countriesappeared={{United States}}
{{Canada}} |image = Yankee Swap.jpeg}}'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (also known as the '''Prize Swapping Competition''') is a recurring [[Power of Veto]] and [[Head of Household]] competition. It is unique among competitions in that the winner of the competition does not automatically win the POV or HOH. This competition is notable for being the one that causes an unlucky houseguest to wear a [[Unitard]] for a week or be in [[Solitary Confinement]] for 24 hours. For French-Canadian Celebrity Versions, Yankee Swap was combined with the [[OTEV]] competitions.
